construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

Palo Alto ARB staff report (2017-02-02, 15PLN-00248): demolish four single-story single-family homes built 1953-1968 and build 16 two-story single-family homes with basements, consistent with a previously approved tentative map of 16 lots and a private street. Five homes front Maybell Avenue (four sharing two driveways); 11 interior homes are reached by a private street from Clemo Avenue. Zoning R-2 (0.81 acres) and RM-15 (1.65 acres); the RM-15 portion is a vacant former orchard. The tentative map was evaluated in a Mitigated Negative Declaration. Neighborhood: Green Acres.

City of Palo Alto project page: application 17PLN-00158, a Final Map to create 16 new parcels of about 5,000 to 6,184 sq ft; zoning R-2 and RM-15; applicant John Koroyan; project planner Sheldon Ahsing.
